documentation.description:
Given a non-negative integer type, return a fixed-width decimal character string padded with leading zeros.

: @generic Natural_Type  Signed integer type to convert (must be ≥ 0)
: @generic Width         Desired length of the result string
: @param   Value         Value to convert
: @return                Fixed-width decimal string of length Width

subprograms.name: Generic_Image
Generic_Zero_Padded_Image
Image
subprograms.code:
function Image
   (Value : in Interfaces.Integer_16;
    Width : in Positive := Interfaces.Integer_16'Width - 1)
    return String
